Text.SourceString: （连接）——拉薇，汇报情况。
Text.LocalizedString: (Connected) - Lawine, report your status.

Text.SourceString: 我已经进入防御系统，这里看起来……不太稳定。
Text.LocalizedString: I've entered the defense system. It looks... very unstable.

Text.SourceString: 系统随时可能坍塌，时间紧迫，我来指引你攻破它。
Text.LocalizedString: The system could collapse at any moment. Time's running out. I'll guide you through.

Text.SourceString: 收到。
Text.LocalizedString: Copy that.

Text.SourceString: 当你靠近带有“弦化滑行”标识的墙面时，可以在上面行走。
Text.LocalizedString: Approach a stickable wall and stringify to move on it.

Text.SourceString: 就是这样，保持住。
Text.LocalizedString: That's it. Keep it up.

Text.SourceString: 这个距离……弦化后飘飞过去吧。
Text.LocalizedString: It's quite far... Stringify and glide across.

Text.SourceString: 贴墙，继续。
Text.LocalizedString: Wall-stick and keep moving.

Text.SourceString: 不愧是拉薇，做得不错。
Text.LocalizedString: Well done, Lawine, as expected.

Text.SourceString: 不过，坍塌的速度加快了，要小心。
Text.LocalizedString: But the collapse is speeding up. Stay alert.

Text.SourceString: 这里没有常规通路，弦化，侧身。
Text.LocalizedString: No regular path here. Stringify and sidestep through the gap.

Text.SourceString: 我果然没有看错你。
Text.LocalizedString: I knew I wasn't wrong about you.

Text.SourceString: 很少听到你的夸奖。
Text.LocalizedString: Rare to hear you compliment someone.

Text.SourceString: 我只是在陈述事实罢了。
Text.LocalizedString: I'm simply stating the facts.

Text.SourceString: 借用气流飞跃过去！
Text.LocalizedString: Use the airflow to glide across!

Text.SourceString: 很好。前方是科摩斯格纳库，人工智能守卫已经被明控制，你趁机摧毁它们。
Text.LocalizedString: Great! Komos' garage is up ahead. The AI guards are under Ming's control, destroy them while you have the chance.

Text.SourceString: 好枪法。
Text.LocalizedString: Nice shooting.

Text.SourceString: 漂亮，极高的命中率。
Text.LocalizedString: Splendid. Your accuracy is second to none.

Text.SourceString: 目标完全摧毁，做得好，继续前进吧。
Text.LocalizedString: The target has been annihilated. Great work. Keep moving.

Text.SourceString: 怎么回事？
Text.LocalizedString: What's wrong?

Text.SourceString: 报告，防御系统自动更新，香奈美处理不了！
Text.LocalizedString: Report, the defense system just auto-updated, Kanami can't stop it!

Text.SourceString: 敌人位置不明，使用主动技能，确定敌方坐标。
Text.LocalizedString: The enemy's location is unknown. Use your active skill to expose the enemy's coordinates.

Text.SourceString: 不行，敌人火力太过密集，紧急回避，不要恋战。
Text.LocalizedString: No good, enemy fire is too dense. Take evasive action, do not get bogged down.

Text.SourceString: 使用终极技能隐身，不要让敌人发现你。
Text.LocalizedString: Use your Ultimate Skill for Stealth. Stay hidden from enemies.

Text.SourceString: 损毁率低于预期值，很不错。出口即将坍塌，尽快逃离。
Text.LocalizedString: Damage rate lower than expected. Excellent. The exit is collapsing, escape quickly.
